name: Galaxy Fox claim contract unprotected setMerkleRoot
summary: The unverified GFOX airdrop/claim contract's setMerkleRoot(bytes32) writes the Merkle root to storage slot 3 without any caller check. The attacker set a root equal to its own leaf and called claim with an empty proof, withdrawing 1.34B GFOX and selling it into the GFOX/WETH Uniswap V2 pair; three copycat transactions by two other actors repeated the same calls within about two hours and emptied the contract.
notes: Immutable claim runtime has an unguarded setMerkleRoot; owner root updates and funding do not introduce the missing check.

The claim contract's entire GFOX balance (1,780,453,099.185 GFOX) was taken in four transactions: the anchor (1,335,339,824.38875), copycat bot 0xcc3a5dc003b3a58621745a39f706ef9646d5c481 in source-6 and source-7 (333,834,956.0971875 and 83,458,739.024296875) and 0x14b362d2e38250604f21a334d71c13e2ed478467 in source-8 (27,819,579.674765625, sold in source-9). GFOX is valued by realised proceeds: the GFOX/WETH pair 0x92ee0df7f6b0674cabc9bfc64873786fa7be82d0 paid out 108.744009594558929771 + 5.081096386975926775 + 1.344190519511096579 + 2.329061044327335573 = 117.498357545373288698 WETH for the dumped tokens, valued at the WETH quote at the anchor time (3035.7 USD; all legs within 2h16m). Token transfer tax taken from the stolen GFOX is not counted, so this is a lower bound.
